web-guide-idea-36.audience: Designers, writers or developers seeking a second pair of eyes.
web-guide-idea-36.offer: Review a portfolio in your area of competence and help the creator communicate their best work. Choose a few projects rather than promising a complete redesign.
web-guide-idea-36.steps.0: Ask about the intended audience and select projects.
web-guide-idea-36.steps.1: Review the opening, project story and evidence of decisions.
web-guide-idea-36.steps.2: Prioritise a few improvements the creator can make next.
web-guide-idea-36.equipment: A phone can carry the call, but a laptop is usually useful for viewing the portfolio closely.
web-guide-idea-36.returnReason: A second session can review the revised presentation or a new project with different questions.
web-guide-idea-36.promotion: Publish a short critique of your own sample project to show what your feedback covers.
web-guide-idea-36.metadataTitle: Portfolio Feedback — Creator Idea & Practical Guide · Saathum
web-guide-idea-36.metadataDescription: Review a design, writing, photography or development portfolio and suggest concrete improvements. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
